newsitem.title: USA: Handy & Harman Q4 shr lower.
newsitem.headline: Handy & Harman Q4 shr lower.

text.p: (a) Revenue and expenses for 1996 and 1995 restated to reflect the sale of refining division business now accounted for as a discontinued operation. Results and an after-tax charge associated with exiting this business totaling $14,515,000 or $1.05 per share was recorded in 1996.

(b) As a result of reductions in the quantities of precious metal inventories valued under the LIFO, income from continuing operations before taxes for the quarter and twelve months ended December 31, 1996 rose $28,510,000 ($16,347,000 after-tax or $1.22 per share) and $33,630,000 ($19,260,000 after-tax or $1.40 per share), respectively.

(c) The 1995 discontinued operations also include the results of the company's automotive original equipment business, the sale of which was completed at the end of 1995 and for which the company recorded an after-tax gain of $11,496,000.

(d) In the second quarter of 1995, the company recorded nonrecurring charges of $9,549,000 in the precious metal segment (after tax $6,150,000 or $.44 per share), for costs related to the decision to exit the karat gold fabricated product line in East Providence, R.I., and additional costs primarily related to the company's ongoing operation in Fairfield, Conn.

(e) The company was only able to recognize a minor state tax benefit for the precious metal segment's nonrecurring charge taken in the second quarter of 1995 which caused the effective tax rate to be higher in 1995 over 1996.
